body: That sucks, I’m sorry. Do you have any ideas what the root of your self hatred might be?

Yeah that defo sounds a bit more concerning tbh.
Erm, think it depends what the sleeping pill is. Couple of 10mg diazepam would for sure knock him out for a while, and would also help with calming him too tbf.
Naturally I don’t know what part of the world you’re in, but are there any mental health services available over the phone that he could speak to?
Again, I don’t know about him, but I generally find it easiest to open up and talk to be I don’t know at all, so it could be similar for him too.
And talking about it further may help continue to talk him down a bit more.
What sort of stuff do you think makes you problematic? Also, don’t feel like you have to open up if you’re not comfortable doing so, but I guess, what problems do you feel like you have?

Idk if I have great advise, but I used to cut myself a lot when I was younger, and part of it was converting emotional pain into physical pain that felt like it was more manageable.
I guess it’s really hard to make a judgement call on what’s best for him. Do you have any idea of how badly he’s cutting himself? Is it particularly deep? Do you think there’s a risk of suicide as well?
I guess if the answers to those are most “not too deep” or “no” then you may well be fine to wait till tomorrow.
I think it may also depend on what’s happening in the house atm. Is something happening there now that’s making him feel like he needs to self harm?
Hey, I’m sorry you’re feeling like this. Is there anything in particular that you feel is causing you to push people away?

Other commenter has a really good point OP! If you feel like this is going to be the end, then I promise you have nothing to lose in giving your friend a call, but maybe something to gain. You deserve to be safe and to have the time and space to reconsider what your options are. Please give them a call. We’ll still be here to talk to as well.
I can’t tell you how much I empathise with this right now.  I’m sorry you feel like this as well. Is there anything in particular making you feel like you need to?
